detection_dimensions.technique: whitespace-and-Unicode-normalized exact comparison when full text available
normalize spacing, punctuation and unicode; compare titles
SequenceMatcher descriptive similarity >= 0.82 (candidate review threshold, not validated)
topic planning record links known overlapping older passage IDs
editorial evaluation of central claim, facts, question, objectives
author-attribute distribution and prose-level intro/structure/ending comparison when provenance and full texts exist
count age-group and level coverage, do not equalize topic-area counts by default

duplicate_may_be_allowed_when: different reading objectives with substantively different evidence
legitimate revision with distinct passage version
same passage reused in independent learning sessions, if exposure rules allow
exposure_rule: Repeated use of same passage_id in different session_id/slot_index is training scheduling, not duplication of source content; unseen-passage assessment must inspect exposure history separately.
limitations: This audit does not establish semantic paraphrase similarity, originality, usage rights or study validity.
